phase_prompt.summary: The King in his prime state of royal authority, intact and commanding.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: Cinematic close-up of the King, intact and sovereign. He wears a crown of dull gold fused with technical sensors. His beard is perfectly groomed, skin flawless dark bronze. He looks directly into the lens with absolute authority. Background is a deep, blurred throne room of industrial stone. High contrast, sharp focus, incredibly detailed fabric textures and metal weathering.
